Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Tai Si was the mother of King Cheng of Zhou (and thus King Kang’s paternal grandmother), conflating King Wu’s mother (Tai Si) with King Cheng’s mother. This misinterpretation of the lineage (and overreliance on a SERP snippet without proper verification) led to the wrong identification; reliable sources indicate Yi Jiang is King Cheng’s mother and therefore King Kang’s paternal grandmother.
